name: Directory Page
description: Guidance for a workspace directory page that combines page context, search/filter controls, result summary, a governed Table for non-empty results, and governed Empty State for zero results.

structure.role: Provide page title, description, breadcrumbs, and optional page-level actions through the governed Page Heading.
Place the governed Search Field at logical inline-start and product-owned result summary at logical inline-end in wide layouts.
Render the governed Table when one or more results exist; render the governed Empty State instead when the result set is empty.

layout.statement: Use the governed layout region gap between Page Heading, directory controls, and the results region.
In wide layouts, arrange Search Field and result summary on one row with search at logical inline-start and summary at logical inline-end.
A constrained Search Field width may be used only when approved product/Figma evidence supplies that width; otherwise allow the container to determine available width.
When the governed Table minimum width exceeds available inline space, the directory results wrapper owns horizontal overflow rather than compressing Table below its contract.

responsive.statement: Below the governed expanded-shell breakpoint, stack the directory controls vertically and allow the result summary to wrap.
Derive the wide/compact transition from the governed Application Shell breakpoint; do not invent a new directory breakpoint from Storybook fixture widths.

direction.statement: Use logical inline alignment so search/summary placement mirrors with the surrounding RTL/LTR direction without physical left/right rules.
Product data with known intrinsic LTR direction, such as email addresses or project keys, may set a narrower LTR direction without changing the surrounding directory direction.

accessibility.statement: Search Field must have a product-appropriate accessible label and localized clear-button label.
Repeated Table actions must expose record-specific accessible names rather than relying on identical visible labels alone.

behavior.statement: Filtering and result counts are product state; switch between Table and Empty State based on the actual result set instead of rendering fake empty rows.
If a Table row is visually selected, that selection represents association with open contextual detail, not bulk-selection state.

allowed.statement: Local composition CSS may arrange the Search Field and product summary because that layout is outside either component's public API.
A local Search Field width is allowed only when the supplied product/Figma evidence explicitly owns the dimension.

forbidden: custom search input when governed Search Field satisfies the requirement
custom table or grid replacing governed Table for the supported four-region directory
fake empty Table rows instead of governed Empty State
physical left/right layout rules for search and summary
copying Storybook evidence-frame dimensions into product UI without independent authority
